fullDesc: On October 14, 1066 William, Duke of Normandy, defeated King Harold Godwinson at the Battle of Hastings. William became king of England and the Norman conquest changed English language, law and landholding.
realFacts: Harold had just beaten a Norse invasion in the north
William was crowned on Christmas Day 1066
The Bayeux Tapestry records the story
The Domesday Book surveyed the country in 1086
